notes.title: Merge Together v1.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Reduced the size of the pineapple collider.
[*] Resolved an issue where lobbies remained open even after being closed.
[*] Fixed Vsync issues.
[*] Addressed an issue with the fruit merge sound effect.
[*] Fixed multiple merging of fruits in offline mode.
[*] Corrected an issue where the game continued on one player's screen after ending on another.
[*] Enhanced the visibility of the red line.
[/list]
